title.zh: PHP披露两个严重远程代码执行漏洞，CVSS评分均为9.2
title.en: 【慢雾：PHP 存在两个严重安全漏洞，建议相关团队排查使用 PHP 的服务器及业务系统】

current_state.zh: PHP正因提前泄露而紧急准备于10月21日发布针对两个最高危「php2shell」远程代码执行漏洞的补丁，技术细节尚未完全公开，防御方在补丁前处于被动监控状态。
current_state.en: PHP is preparing an emergency October 21 patch for two top-severity 'php2shell' remote code execution vulnerabilities after an early leak, with technical details still not fully public and defenders monitoring for exploitation indicators.

updates.what_changed_zh: SlowMist warned that PHP contains two critical CVSS 9.2 vulnerabilities potentially allowing remote code execution, urging teams to audit PHP-based servers and business systems and to apply the official patch scheduled for release at 22:00 Beijing time on October 21.
